record.question: Choose the correct homophone to fill in the blank: __________ of this hill is very steep.
record.explanation: Answer A: descent. The noun “descent” means a downward slope or movement. “Decent” is an adjective; “descends” is a verb. Original paper prints three choices; the empty imported fourth slot was removed after visual source inspection. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
